note: Graphic templates shared by the Premiere still renderer (and the optional AE builder). Geometry in px for 1080x1920. A client profile may override any value; style should come from that client's reference videos.

highlight_caption.desc: Animated caption: white serif text pops in; on keyword cues a brand-teal box sweeps in right-to-left behind it (Ref 1/3).

hook_title.desc: Opening hook line(s): larger serif with a teal bar (bar_style 'underline' = half-height marker, 'box' = full box like statements), scale-up pop.

term_callout.desc: Important term / English term: bold white word with teal underline wipe.

glass_card.desc: Key statement on a frosted-glass rounded card with small glass-cube icon top-right.

checklist.desc: Title + bulleted items with outline circles; each item reveals at its spoken time.

broll_card.desc: Full-screen brand-tint paper background, headline at top, rounded image card centre. Covers the speaker.

photo_card.desc: Approved client photo in rounded frame with logo bug and optional caption line.

name_card.desc: Frosted outline name card: name line, divider rules, affiliation lines (from approved reference wording).

cta.desc: Spoken call-to-action emphasised with teal pill + logo bug.

stat_card.desc: Podcast success stories: a big number or result in the brand primary over a frosted card, one line under it (value + label from the speaker's words).

context_card.desc: Podcast reels that need context: one editorial line in a brand pill at the top (what came before this moment). Not the speaker's words.

logo_outro.desc: Closing logo lock-up on white with teal monogram.

flash_transition.desc: Soft white bloom flash used entering/leaving full-screen B-roll (seen in references).

statement_highlight.desc: Key statement as white serif lines, each on a brand-teal box (Ref 3 style). Boxes sweep in right-to-left, text pops. Replaces mid-video glass cards (glass is reserved for the closing name card).

broll_video.desc: Full-screen licensed B-roll video (from data/Broll), muted, cover-cropped to 9:16 (crop_center optional), hard cut in and out. Captions stay on top. Params: video (rel path), in (seconds into the clip, default 0), crop_center [x,y] 0-1.
